questions.question: A Neo4j database schema can be modified after data has been ingested by refactoring the data.
Which of the following statements is correct?
options: Neo4j allows for an optional schema.

questions.question: An index in Neo4j makes data retrieval more efficient and can improve query performance.
Which of the following indexes are available in Neo4j?

Complete the Cypher statement below to create an existence constraint on the rated property on the ()-[:RATED]->() relationship.

CREATE CONSTRAINT rated_rating
FOR ()-[r:RATED]-() REQUIRE r.rating -- select --
Which of the following Cypher statements will visualize your database schema?
What makes fulltext and vector indexes different from other indexes in Neo4j?
options: They are not automatically used by the query planner for ordinary pattern matching.
They can be specified for properties of relationships.
They can be used to constrain uniqueness of a relationship property value.
They must be queried by calling a procedure.

questions.question:
Complete the Cypher statement below to query a fulltext index called movieInfo with the value in the parameter $query.

-- select --("movieInfo", $query)
YIELD node, score
RETURN node.title, score
How do you create a unique constraint on the email property for any node with the label User?
options: CREATE CONSTRAINT FOR (u:User) REQUIRE (u.email) IS UNIQUE.
CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (u:User) ASSERT u.email IS NODE KEY.
CREATE CONSTRAINT ON (u:User) ASSERT u.email IS UNIQUE.

questions.question: You can create an index on nodes or relationships.
How do you create a RANGE index on a relationship property?
options: CREATE RANGE INDEX index_name FOR ()-[relType:RELATIONSHIP_TYPE]-() ON (relType.property_key).
CREATE FULLTEXT INDEX index_name FOR (n:NODE_LABEL) ON (n.property_key).
CREATE TEXT INDEX index_name FOR ()-[relType:RELATIONSHIP_TYPE]-() ON (relType.property_key).
CREATE BTREE INDEX index_name FOR (n:NODE_LABEL) ON (n.property_key).

questions.question: What type of constraint can you use to ensure that two or more properties are unique and exist for any given label?
What is the purpose of a unique constraint in Neo4j?
options: To ensure that a property value is unique for all nodes with a specific label.
To enforce referential integrity between nodes.
To prevent relationships from being created.
To ensure that all nodes have a label.
